bagPolicy.summary: Only one bag per person measuring at most 29 × 21 × 15 cm is allowed after search; there is no storage for larger bags. Coat check is £3.50 per item or £5 for a permitted filled bag.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: There is no public on-site event parking; use nearby multi-storey car parks or public transport.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The visitor FAQ mentions ride services but does not specify a designated pickup location.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Arena foyers sell food and beverages, and free drinking water is available. Re:Fuel serves fries, hotdogs and pizza in the main foyer.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Contact the arena’s access team before arrival with medical equipment, medicines or food needed for a medical condition; accessible booking information is on its dedicated page.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The arena FAQ describes its outdoor smoking area but does not state a general concert rule for leaving and re-entering the venue.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The general FAQ directs patrons to the box-office page for collection but does not itself set a universal ID or collection procedure.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Doors normally open about one hour before the performance; the ticket or event page gives the show’s actual time. Have tickets and small bags ready for scanning and search.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
